floor_history.headline: func_8003553C honest pure-C floor 17 -> 4: cheat-asm carrier replaced with pure C; two confirmed levers (may-alias-pinned OT-base load hoisted into a local mid-body; 640-valued store leading the body

frontier.hypothesis: The original coordinate block is the PsyQ setXYWH(p, x, y, w, h) expansion, whose x1 = x + w and y2 = y + h subexpressions create the 640 and 240 values (640 first) at points independent of the store order, with CSE giving each value two uses — which would materialize li $v1,640 at the block head while leaving the +0x10 store in the trailing group.
frontier.mechanism: CSE creates one pseudo per repeated subexpression at its first occurrence in the RTL stream; the constant-folded sum insn is what sched1 floats to the head of the block, decoupling constant materialization order from store order (which is what the current score-4 form cannot do, since it uses the store itself to materialize the constant).
frontier.next_probe: Rewrite the coordinate block as the setXYWH expansion (all eight fields ascending, values written as x + w and y + h sums) while keeping the `ot` local from H1 in place; sweep the position of the sums relative to the RGB block; compare the emitted li order and the sh $v1,0x10 position against the side-by-side diff in tmp/grind/func_8003553C/s1/forms_and_scores.md.

frontier.hypothesis: addiu $s0,$s0,0x24 can be pulled ahead of the jal by a source shape that makes the advanced pointer's definition necessarily precede the call while keeping the sw to D_800A38B4 after it.
frontier.mechanism: sched1 will place a register-only add in a pre-jal slot when the value is defined before the call in the RTL stream; the store must stay after the call because a call clobbers memory and cannot be crossed by the global store.
frontier.next_probe: Read .claude/rules/store-before-jal.md and .claude/rules/defer-store-past-later-compute-into-jal-delay.md for the established shapes, then measure those spellings; do not re-measure the two forms already killed (assignment moved before the call; value staged in a plain extra local).

frontier.hypothesis: The remaining two positions are reachable by pure statement-order search from the score-4 base.
frontier.mechanism: The search space left is entirely statement ordering within one basic block, which is what the permuter randomizes best, and the base is now 4 rather than 17.
frontier.next_probe: Build a clean single-function target.o from asm/funcs/func_8003553C.s + tools/decomp-permuter/prelude.inc (function at offset 0, drop the .set gp=64 line) per .claude/rules/difficult-is-not-impossible.md §3, seed from memory/grind/func_8003553C/candidate.c, and run a fresh-seed campaign with tools/permuter_campaign.py — waiting for it in-turn and harvesting before writing the outcome.
